<STBG 5,0><BGM 0,0,504><MWT 5>At <COL FEEB4EFF>Zugu Settlement</COL>, in <COL FEEB4EFF>daylight</COL>,
I saw a fish walking there.

<MWT 4>That fish came out of the water
and walked using all its fins.

<MWT 4>I tried to capture that wondrous sight,
but was blown away by <COL FEEB4EFF>a Bulldrome</COL>.
